intro: Token spans connect a processed word back to its source text. That alignment supports highlighting, annotation, and debugging a text pipeline.
task: Extract ASCII alphabetic words and their original half-open character spans.
requirements: Return a list of [word, start, end] for maximal ASCII letter runs [A-Za-z]+. Offsets count Python Unicode code points; end is exclusive. Digits, accents, and punctuation separate words.
Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Find maximal contiguous letter runs rather than splitting on spaces.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Compute positions in the original text before any normalization.

explanation: Token spans connect a processed word back to its source text. That alignment supports highlighting, annotation, and debugging a text pipeline.
This tokenizer is intentionally ASCII-specific. It does not claim to tokenize every language; its explicit alphabet makes the boundary behavior testable.
